summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 10, 2026 press release announcing initiation of clinical and commercial GMP manufacturing of oxypurinol drug substance and XORLO tablets supporting the XRX-OXY-102 two-part clinical study and a future FDA NDA. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is an operational milestone update signed by Co-CEO Allen Davidoff. Neither a merger, tender, activist, spin-off, nor forced management change is present. Watch only for clinical/regulatory catalysts, not deal terms or arbitrage.
